body.stop_condition: On the physics/symplectic-reconstruction adoption corpus, run shadow-import-all and preserve its imported certificate and claim identities. Supply a deterministic conversion/discovery command or integrated paper-coverage input adapter that: (1) enumerates all imported certificate/result candidates and every technical paper and overview; (2) emits an explicit HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED materiality queue rather than inferring materiality; (3) imports existing typed paper-coverage overlays and claim maps without duplicating identities; (4) creates or requests typed paper-claim and result-to-paper dispositions while keeping overview-only distinct from technical coverage; (5) reports source-kind and converted-kind counts; and (6) refuses or emits a prominent INCOMPATIBLE_NONEMPTY_GRAPH finding when a nonempty graph contains certificate/claim evidence but zero vocabulary nodes understood by paper-coverage. Prove with deterministic fixtures that a 1,359-certificate/1,022-claim-style legacy graph cannot yield results=0, papers=0, review_queue=0 without an incompatibility finding, that a genuinely empty graph is distinguished, that an annotation overlay yields a nonempty audit, and that no AI-generated annotation is labeled human-authored. Replay against the current physics corpus and produce a nonempty unclassified review queue plus paper inventory; do not require the corpus to be fully human-classified before landing the adapter.
body.forbid: no vacuous advisory pass for an incompatible nonempty graph; no filename, embedding, citation-count or prose-similarity materiality inference; no certificate-count called publication debt; no overview mention counted as technical coverage; no auto-authored HUMAN annotations; no lossy replacement of source certificate or claim IDs; no release verdict until human dispositions and current evidence edges exist
